title: How to speed up the Rust compiler in September 2026
summary: An article by prominent Rust compiler contributor nnethercote discussing techniques and strategies for improving Rust compiler (rustc) compilation speed, addressing one of the most common pain points in the Rust ecosystem.
problem_solved: Addresses the long-standing issue of slow Rust compilation times that impacts developer productivity.
why_valuable: Faster compilation directly improves developer experience and productivity, which is critical for Rust adoption and daily development workflows.
